experimental_note: EXPERIMENTAL: articulated-body (joint) extension track. Not the shipped model; the shipped box model is models/contact_gnn.pt. Synthetic PyBullet box-link articulations only.

format.states: float32 [E,T+1,N=12,13] pos3 (box centre), quat xyzw (sign-continuous), linvel3, angvel3 (world); Y-up metres
format.rest: bool [E,T+1,N] dynamic object in contact and |v|<0.01 and |w|<0.05
format.tipped: bool [E,N] body +Y axis more than 35 deg from world up on any frame (agatha.physics.summarize semantics; trivially true for links that start that way)
format.kind: <U24 [E] generator scenario ('plain_<kind>' = jointless scene from generate_contact_data.make_case)
format.episode_index: int64 [E] index within the split (seed = hash(base_seed, split, index))
format.init_penetration: float32 [E] deepest object-object/support/floor overlap at t=0 (m, >=0)
format.joints: float32 [E,J=12,18] parent_slot (-1 = world), child_slot, one-hot [hinge, ball, prismatic, fixed], anchor_parent xyz (parent body frame; WORLD point when parent_slot=-1), anchor_child xyz (child body frame), axis xyz (unit, parent body frame = child body frame at coordinate 0; world when parent_slot=-1; zeros for ball/fixed), lower, upper (rad / m; -+3.2 or -+10 when unlimited; 0,0 for ball/fixed), joint_damping (N m s/rad, N s/m for prismatic)
format.joint_pos: float32 [E,T+1,J] hinge angle (rad, wrapped to (-pi,pi]) / prismatic displacement (m); 0 for ball/fixed
format.group: int8 [E,N] articulation id of the body (0,1,..), -1 for free bodies and empty slots
format.joint_anchor_gap: float32 [E] diagnostic: max over frames and joints of |world anchor from parent - from child| (m), recomputed from the stored float32 states
format.joint_axis_error: float32 [E] diagnostic: max hinge-axis / prismatic / fixed misalignment (rad)
format.joint_pos_error: float32 [E] diagnostic: max |joint_pos - coordinate recomputed from the states|

ranges.table: w 0.9-1.5, d 0.65-1.0, h 0.6-0.9; demo desk 1.2x0.8x0.75 in 40% of jointed episodes; never tilted in jointed episodes
ranges.link_mass_kg: density 200-2000 kg/m3 x volume clipped to 0.02-5 (laptop/doll/cabinet ranges below)
ranges.unobservable: as generate_contact_data: 45% 'live' episodes (restitution/rolling/spinning 0, support friction 0.5); otherwise each of the five parameters randomized with p=0.7
ranges.free_boxes: 0-3 per jointed episode (0-2 with a ragdoll), resting on the table, 15% airborne, sometimes thrown at the articulation
ranges.laptop: base 0.25-0.38 x 0.012-0.025 x 0.18-0.27 (0.6-1.6 kg), lid 5-12 mm (0.15-0.6 kg), hinge 0..105-140 deg, damping 0.002-0.3; open at a random angle; lid pushed, base pushed / at the edge / dropped / tossed / hit
ranges.door: static post (70%) or free-standing heavy box (30%) + panel 0.12-0.35 wide on a vertical hinge, limits +-1.2-2.8 rad or one-sided, pushed open 1-8 rad/s or hit by a thrown box
ranges.drawer: cabinet 0.15-0.4 x 0.08-0.25 x 0.15-0.35 (static 45%), horizontal slider 0..0.5-0.85 x drawer depth, damping 0.01-3 N s/m, pushed up to 2 m/s; 20% vertical 'lift' slider falling to its limit
ranges.pendulum: world anchor above the table, rod 0.15-0.45 m (+ fixed bob 40%, second link 25%), hinge 65% / ball 35%, released up to +-1.9 rad or swung at 2-6 rad/s, bob clears the table by 5-60 mm
ranges.chain: 3-6 links 0.06-0.14 m, ball (45%) / parallel hinges (25%) / alternating hinges (30%); hanging from a world anchor, lying on the table / draped over an edge / pushed, dropped, tossed
ranges.robot_arm: static base on the table, 2-4 hinge links 0.1-0.28 m with vertical/horizontal axes, damping 0.001-0.3 (15% stiff 0.3-1.5), limits +-1.6-2.9 rad / none / asymmetric, optional fixed end pad; released from a random pose
ranges.ragdoll: 10 boxes, height 0.44-0.78 m; ball or limited-hinge neck/shoulders/hips, limited hinge elbows/knees; dropped, tossed, standing and pushed, sitting on the table edge, lying at the edge and pushed
ranges.joint_damping: requested value capped at 0.25 x reduced inertia of the two joined boxes / dt (Bullet integrates joint damping explicitly); the recorded joint_damping is the value actually simulated
ranges.kicks: an impulse on one link applied as a force over 3 substeps before frame 0
ranges.dropped: non-finite states, |pos|>50, y<-0.5, |x|,|z|>10, speed>40 m/s, spin>200 rad/s, anchor gap > 1 mm, axis error > 2 mrad, joint_pos mismatch > 2e-3, hinge beyond a limit by > 0.3 rad / slider by > 0.03 m, no valid scene after 30 build attempts

meta.engine: PyBullet Featherstone multibodies (createMultiBody links), fixedTimeStep 1/240, 50 solver iterations, linear/angular damping 0.04, joint motors disabled, self-collision on except parent-child (URDF_USE_SELF_COLLISION_EXCLUDE_PARENT)
meta.rest_definition: in contact and |v|<0.01 m/s and |w|<0.05 rad/s
meta.contact_definition: Bullet contact point with distance <= 0.001 m in the last substep (frame 0: closest-point query); contact_object includes non-adjacent links of the same articulation; jointed pairs never touch
meta.chaotic_definition: any dynamic body fell, became tipped (was not at frame 0), or moved > 0.30 m from its start, or a contact between two dynamic bodies began after t=0 with relative COM speed > 0.5 m/s (velocities of the previous 20 Hz frame); plain_* episodes use the generate_contact_data definition
meta.live_physics_definition: restitution, rolling and spinning friction 0 for every object; support friction 0.5; support restitution 0

data_checks.description: |joint_gnn.joint_coordinates(true states) - dataset joint_pos| over all frames (hinge wrapped to +-pi)

metric_definitions.pos_err_m: mean |p_pred - p_true| over dynamic real bodies at the horizon; joints.pos_err_articulated_m / pos_err_free_m split by the dataset group id (>= 0 = articulated)
metric_definitions.hinge_coord_err_rad: mean |wrap(q_pred - q_true)| over hinge joints, q from joint_gnn.joint_coordinates
metric_definitions.anchor_gap_mm: joint_gnn.joint_violation anchor_gap over all joint-frames t>=1 (mean, max) and at the horizons
metric_definitions.off_axis_deg: joint_gnn.joint_violation off_axis over hinge (axis misalignment) and prismatic/fixed (relative rotation) joint-frames
metric_definitions.limit: limit_excess from joint_gnn.joint_violation over hinge/prismatic joint-frames
metric_definitions.latency_ms_per_step: batch 1, CPU (4 threads), mean over 60 autoregressive steps

physics_reference.description: PyBullet ground truth scored with the same metrics (floor for constraint / penetration / rest metrics)

joint_raw.description: JointGNN alone: learned model only, no projection

joint_projected.description: JointGNN + joint_gnn.project_joints after every step (non-learned contact + joint projection)

contact_projected.description: baseline: box model contact_gnn + contact_gnn.project, joints ignored

hold_initial.description: trivial baseline: every body keeps its initial pose (zero velocity)

notes: EXPERIMENTAL: articulated-body (joint) extension track. Not the shipped model; the shipped box model is models/contact_gnn.pt. Synthetic PyBullet box-link articulations only.
Autoregressive rollouts from the true t=0 state over the full episode; never teacher-forced.
joint_projected applies joint_gnn.project_joints (non-learned contact + joint projection) after every step; joint_raw is the learned model alone.
contact_projected ignores the joints entirely (the shipped box model on the same bodies): the gap to it is what the joint edges buy.

Joint coordinate error compares joint_gnn.joint_coordinates of the predicted and of the TRUE states (hinge error wrapped to +-pi); ball and fixed joints have no coordinate. data_checks reports how well that function reproduces the dataset joint_pos.
Anchor gap / off-axis / limit metrics come from joint_gnn.joint_violation; physics_reference shows PyBullet's own residual.

Limit violation = joint-frames with limit excess > 0.02 rad (hinge) or 0.002 m (prismatic); "> slop" counts only excess beyond joint_gnn.LIMIT_SLOP = 0.05 rad / 0.005 m, the tolerance project_joints itself clamps to (Bullet limits are soft, so physics_reference is non-zero in the strict column).
Penetration = contact_gnn corner-in-box depth (support, floor, other boxes) with pairs directly connected by a joint excluded.
fell / rest drift follow scripts/eval_contact.py (dataset fell flag and rest frames).
Latency: batch 1, CPU (4 threads), 60 autoregressive steps on the first episode with a joint; shared machine, indicative only.

physics_reference.description: PyBullet ground truth scored with the same metrics (floor for constraint / penetration / rest metrics)

joint_raw.description: JointGNN alone: learned model only, no projection (zero joints)

joint_projected.description: JointGNN + joint_gnn.project_joints after every step (non-learned contact + joint projection) (zero joints)

contact_projected.description: baseline: box model contact_gnn + contact_gnn.project, joints ignored

box_regression.note: Same JointGNN checkpoint with zero joints against contact_gnn; deltas are joint_gnn minus contact_gnn (paired episode bootstrap).
